item.title: Good evening, Naresh, and welcome to your Daily Drive this lovely Sunday, June 2...
item.description: Good evening, Naresh, and welcome to your Daily Drive this lovely Sunday, June 21st, 2026 here in Sydney, where it’s a crisp 15°C under clear skies, feeling just a touch cooler at 13°C. After a beautiful day with temperatures reaching 17°C, it's the perfect time to wind down, enjoy a safe journey home, and ease into a relaxing evening. As you make your way, remember that even the longest journey begins with a single step, or in your case, perhaps a perfect song. So, settle in, enjoy your evening Naresh, rest up, and we'll catch you back here tomorrow for another Daily Drive.
